fightSong.title: Eight Seconds
fightSong.lyrics: Ride 'em high, ride 'em hard / Dallas Rodeos run the yard / Eight seconds to glory, eight seconds to fame / Rodeo football, we play the game!

stadium.name: The Corral
stadium.tradition: The Buck-Off — pre-game, a mechanical bull in full Rodeos uniform is ridden by a randomly selected season ticket holder. If they last 8 seconds, the team runs out under a giant lasso. Success rate: 11%.

fanCulture.description: Everything's bigger, including the hats. After every sack, the PA plays a bull snort. Fans do the 'lasso' with rally towels. They arrive late and leave early but they're loud in between.
fanCulture.tailgate: BBQ, but make it Texas. Brisket the size of toddlers. Someone's definitely selling boots.

rivalries.name: The Texas Two-Step
rivalries.narrative: Dallas Rodeos vs Houston Brisket Spaceships. It's cowboys vs astronauts, boots vs boots on the moon. Texas is big enough for both, but we won't admit it.

rivalries.name: The Alamo Rematch
rivalries.narrative: San Antonio Rivers think they're the real Texas. We think they're a tourist trap with a team. It's spicy.

paAnnouncer.firstDownCall: YEE-HAW! That's a Rodeo first down!
paAnnouncer.touchdownCall: TOUCHDOWN DALLAS! Ride that bull to the end zone!

cityFlavor: Oil money, big hats, bigger egos. We do everything at 11. If you ain't first, you're last, and we're always first in our minds.
